payments.question: What does it cost to take payments?
payments.answer: To let clients pay online, you use your own Mollie account. Mollie charges an amount per payment, at their rates. You pay that to Mollie, not to Fivvi. If you only take cash or card, you don't need Mollie.

clients.question: What do my clients pay?
clients.answer: Only what you charge. The app and the website are free for them.

later.question: And if Fivvi starts charging later?
later.answer: You'll hear at least 60 days in advance. You can then stop for free and take your data with you. You never pay for anything you didn't agree to first.

pricing.currency: All amounts are in euros. Because you don't pay Fivvi anything right now, there are no payment terms.

support.metaDescription: Frequently asked questions and how to reach us.
support.headline: Help and contact
support.lead: Feel free to email us. We're happy to help.

join.question: How do I join my studio?
join.answer: Open your studio's or trainer's link, or scan their QR code. Enter your email address, then the 6-digit code you receive. Your studio approves your request and then you can book.

noCode.question: I don't get a code. What now?
noCode.answer: Check your spam and your email address. A code is valid for 15 minutes. After that, just ask for a new one.

cancel.question: How do I cancel a class?
cancel.answer: Open the class and choose Cancel. If you're in time, you get your credit back. Your studio decides how long that's possible.

invoices.question: Where do I find my invoices?
invoices.answer: In Profile, under Invoices. You can download them there too.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: Email {address} from your account's address with the subject Delete account. We'll do it within one month and let you know.

payments.question: How do I connect payments?
payments.answer: On your laptop, go to Settings, Payments, Connect payments. Mollie checks your details. iDEAL works first; automatic direct debit takes up to about 3 working days longer.

mollie.question: Do I have to use Mollie?
mollie.answer: No. If you only take cash or card, that's fine. Fivvi first tells you what you'd miss, and you can always connect Mollie later.

devices.question: Which devices does Fivvi work on?
devices.answer: Fivvi Pro is coming for iPhone and Android. You do the admin in the browser on your laptop. Clients use the app or their browser.

data.question: Where is my data stored?
data.answer: The database is in Amsterdam. Some services are from US companies, with the safeguards the law requires. They're listed under Sub-processors. Notes are for trainers only.

subProcessors.metaDescription: The services that process data for Fivvi, what for, and where they store it.
subProcessors.headline: Sub-processors
subProcessors.lead: These services process data for Fivvi. Railway, Sentry, PostHog and Cloudflare are US companies; the privacy policy explains the safeguards. When a new service is added, we tell every studio first.

purpose.railway: Hosting the website, apps and database
purpose.lettermint: Emails, such as your sign-in code and confirmations
purpose.sentry: Error reports, without names, email addresses or notes

subProcessors.mollie: Mollie processes payments under its own agreement with your studio.
